description: A service finished its end-of-day work for the date; Operations opens the next day when all have replied.

eventId.description: Unique id of this event; the consumer inbox key.

occurredOn.description: Business date on which the event happened.

performedBy.description: Actor id that caused the event, 'system' by default.

date.description: The business date whose end-of-day work is complete.

service.description: Name of the service that completed, in lower case, for example accounts.
